record.original_question: For an n × n matrix A, define c_j = (∑_{#α=j} A[α]) / (n choose j) for j = 0,…,n, where the sum runs over all principal minors of order j. If A is a GKK τ-matrix, must the Newton inequalities c_j^2 ≥ c_{j-1} c_{j+1} hold for every j = 1,…,n−1?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A$ be an $n\times n$ complex matrix. For a subset $\alpha\subseteq\{1,\dots,n\}$ of size $|\alpha|=j$, denote by $A[\alpha]$ the principal minor of $A$ indexed by $\alpha$ (the determinant of the submatrix obtained by selecting rows and columns indexed by $\alpha$), with the convention $A[\emptyset]=1$. Define the normalized averaged principal minors
$$c_j \;=\; \frac{1}{\binom{n}{j}}\sum_{|\alpha|=j} A[\alpha], \qquad j=0,1,\dots,n.$$

A matrix $A$ is called a GKK matrix if all of its principal minors are positive and it is weakly sign-symmetric (i.e., $A[\alpha\cup\{i\},\alpha\cup\{j\}]\cdot A[\alpha\cup\{j\},\alpha\cup\{i\}]\ge 0$ for every index set $\alpha$ and indices $i,j\notin\alpha$, where $A[\beta,\gamma]$ denotes the minor with row set $\beta$ and column set $\gamma$). A matrix $A$ is called a $\tau$-matrix if, for every principal submatrix $B$ of $A$ (including $A$ itself), the spectral radius of $B$ equals an eigenvalue of $B$ and is at least the spectral radius of every principal submatrix of $B$. A GKK $\tau$-matrix is a matrix that is both a GKK matrix and a $\tau$-matrix.

Question: Must every $n\times n$ GKK $\tau$-matrix $A$ satisfy the Newton inequalities
$$c_j^{\,2} \;\ge\; c_{j-1}\, c_{j+1}, \qquad j=1,\dots,n-1\,?$$
artifact.status_search_result: The question is listed among open problems on GKK τ-matrices. Subsequent literature establishes Newton's inequalities for related classes (e.g., M-matrices proven by Holtz, 2005; further monomial/Newton inequalities for p-Newton matrices), but no result in the located sources resolves the Newton-inequalities question for the full class of GKK τ-matrices. No proof or counterexample for the general GKK τ-matrix case was identified.

status_evidence.title: Open problems on GKK tau-matrices
status_evidence.snippet: Several open problems on GKK τ-matrices, raised by examples showing that some such matrices are unstable.
status_evidence.claim: The Newton-inequalities question for GKK τ-matrices is stated as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: M-matrices satisfy Newton's inequalities
status_evidence.snippet: Newton's inequalities are shown to hold for the normalized coefficients of the characteristic polynomial of any nonsingular M-matrix.
status_evidence.claim: Newton's inequalities are established for the subclass of M-matrices, but not for general GKK τ-matrices.

status_evidence.title: Monomial Inequalities for Newton Coefficients and Determinantal Inequalities for p-Newton Matrices
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Newton-type inequalities for various matrix classes.
status_evidence.claim: Related Newton-type results exist but do not settle the GKK τ-matrix case.
